title: Top-level recursive and concurrent library initialization/shutdown coordinator

scope.rationale: These two top-level source functions serialize initialization, support same-thread recursion, initialize mutex/malloc/pcache/OS layers in order, preserve completed layers across late failures, and shut layers down in reverse order. The production public exports now route through one Coordinator owner.
excluded_responsibilities: Individual mutex, malloc, pcache, and OS initialization implementations
sqlite3_config mutation and individual subsystem configuration

dependencies.caller_closure: The two public lifecycle coordinators are assigned. Subsystem hooks are dependencies; mutex, allocator, PCache, and scoped OS/VFS lifecycle owners are concrete.

inputs: Process-global configuration and any concurrent/recursive initialize or shutdown call
outputs: SQLITE_OK or first subsystem initialization failure, with exact final/progress and partial per-layer process state
contracts.ownership: Coordinator owns process lifecycle state and borrows subsystem owners. Initialization hooks acquire their own resources; late failure preserves completed layers for retry or shutdown.
contracts.state_and_results: Repeated initialize and shutdown are idempotent. Same-thread recursive initialization returns OK. Other threads wait. Failure restores uninitialized state and permits retry.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: A process init lock/condition serializes callers. Hooks run outside the coordinator lock in mutex, malloc, pcache, then OS order and reverse shutdown order.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: First failed hook preserves prior successful layers, clears progress, wakes waiters, and allows deterministic retry; shutdown later clears partial state.

representation_differences: C uses Sqlite3Config flags, a recursive static master mutex, and nRefInitMutex; Coordinator uses an explicit state enum, owner thread id, pthread mutex, and condition variable, while still allocating configured STATIC_MAIN and recursive init handles so callback and OOM behavior is preserved.
C names fixed PCache/OS functions; Coordinator uses staged hook transport backed by concrete process PCache and Unix/mem VFS owners, with the scoped OS owner trace-equivalent.

Production exports and internal process users now share process_coordinator. memory.processManager asserts startup, and only builtin test compilation may locally start the test process Manager; production no longer has a memory-only lazy-start/shutdown path.

oracle.protocol: Infrastructure C/Zig differential runs 100 repeated configure/init/idempotent-init/shutdown cycles, an eight-thread 100-call race, and a configured-mutex/configured-PCache failure-retry trace. The latter compares failure result, partial isMutexInit/isMallocInit/isPCacheInit/isInit state, repeated xMutexInit on recursive/retry calls, successful retry, reverse shutdown, and final state. Native tests additionally cover recursive init-mutex allocation OOM, production owner identity, callback counts, automatic-extension reset, directory clearing after allocator shutdown, partial failure, and reconfiguration.
internal_observations: hook ordering/counts, including repeated xMutexInit on recursive and retry calls
oracle.normalization: Private lock/condition identities and explicit-state versus flag representation are ignored; events, state transitions, and results are exact.

assurance.oom: Allocator failure, recursive init-mutex allocation failure, PCache failure, and late-hook partial-state preservation/retry are tested; per-cache allocation OOM remains outside the lifecycle unit.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Concurrent and recursive init are tested; PCache and scoped OS/VFS hooks are trace-equivalent with the complete active Linux Unix table.
assurance.malformed_input: Not input-driven; invalid configuration timing returns misuse.
assurance.continuation: Failure retry and repeated shutdown are tested.
assurance.performance: Condition-variable serialization differs from source init-mutex refcount and needs review.

integration.native_call_path: src/core/public_api.zig sqlite3_initialize/shutdown and auto-initializing utility paths call global.initializeProcess/shutdownProcess.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Direct public start/stop of memory.process_manager was retired; one production Coordinator now owns process lifecycle.

independent_review.notes: Requires exact top-level lifecycle/refcount event traces, public configuration consolidation, assurance, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port and integrate source builtin-function registry reset/registration performed inside sqlite3_initialize before this unit can be source-translated.
Complete nRefInitMutex waiter-lifetime and configured lock-callback event equivalence; retry/recursive xMutexInit and init-mutex OOM are now covered.
Configured mutex methods and typed process configuration are wired into lifecycle; consolidation into the final public configuration domain and independent review remain open.
